summary: Background removal on your own machine: rembg behind a CLI and a localhost page with drag-and-drop, batch processing, background replacement and export at full resolution. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

stack.why: open models that run on a laptop CPU

stack.choice: Python 3.11+, a stdlib or FastAPI server on localhost

prerequisites.name: A terminal and a code editor
prerequisites.why: Every step below is a command you type or a file you edit.
prerequisites.get: VS Code (code.visualstudio.com), Cursor or Zed. Open a folder for the project and use the editor's built-in terminal.
prerequisites.verify: You can open a folder and run a command in its terminal

prerequisites.name: Git
prerequisites.why: History for your code, and the way most hosts deploy.
prerequisites.get: Install from git-scm.com or with your package manager, then run git init in the project folder once it exists.

prerequisites.name: Python 3.11 or newer with pip
prerequisites.get: python.org or your package manager; use a virtual environment.

prerequisites.name: rembg and its models
prerequisites.why: The whole engine. Models download on first use (hundreds of MB).
prerequisites.get: python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install 'rembg[cli]' onnxruntime
prerequisites.cost: free, a few GB of disk

prerequisites.name: Test images: a portrait, a product on white, something with hair
prerequisites.why: Each phase is judged on real results.

env.name: REMBG_MODEL
env.where: Default model; birefnet for hair, u2net for speed.

phases.title: The CLI
phases.goal: cut in.jpg out.png with model and alpha-matting flags.

steps.do: Create the venv and a cut script wrapping rembg

check: A portrait produces a clean transparent PNG

phases.title: Batch
phases.goal: A folder in, a folder out, resumable.

steps.do: cut --dir in/ out/ with a progress line
Skip already-done files by hash; never overwrite

phases.title: The page
phases.goal: Drop, paste, pick; before/after; only localhost in the network tab.

steps.do: A localhost server with POST /cut returning PNG
The page with three inputs and a before/after slider

check: A dropped image returns in under 5 seconds on CPU
The network tab shows only localhost

phases.title: Backgrounds and export
phases.goal: Replace with color, gradient or image; export at full size; copy.

steps.do: Export at original or chosen size; copy to clipboard

check: A product on a chosen color exports at full resolution

phases.title: Package
phases.goal: One-line install and model sizes stated.

steps.do: Pinned requirements.txt and a Makefile or run script
README with model sizes and the nothing-is-uploaded line

check: A fresh machine reaches a first cutout from the README

phases.title: Run it for a team
phases.goal: A shared instance on your network with a GPU if you have one.

steps.do: Bind to the LAN behind basic auth; onnxruntime-gpu where available
A job queue so ten uploads do not run at once

check: Two people use it concurrently without a crash

product.outcome: Background removal for a small team that never leaves the building.

architecture.swap: A different model behind the same function

operations.backup: Nothing to back up; models re-download.
operations.incident: None of consequence; no data is stored.

notIncluded: Their edge quality on hair and glass.
Plugins, API scale, GPU batch processing.
